releases.title: collectZ v3.31.5
releases.summary: Prevents review actions from closing an incomplete Blu-ray collection traversal and keeps unapplied editions visible after an incremental apply.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Rejects Apply while collection traversal is collecting or paused.
Disables Apply in the review drawer until the batch is ready and explains the wait.
Recomputes lifecycle state after each apply from converted rows, remaining review decisions, enrichment failures, and apply failures.
Keeps a partially applied batch ready and visible with successful conversions preserved.
Marks the batch completed only after no pending review or failed enrichment remains.

releases.title: collectZ v3.31.4
releases.summary: Repairs two live collection-intake failures found after the resilient enrichment release. Browser companion `0.3.2` now recognizes valid Blu-ray product pages whose edition label omits the format, and advances multi-page collection traversal through persisted browser alarms so extension-worker suspension cannot strand a batch after page one.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Falls back from an edition-only subheading to the exact-product release title when determining media format.
Uses the already bounded collection-row format as a final fallback when product-page format parsing remains unresolved.
Treats deterministic parser misses as non-transient instead of repeating the same parse three times.
Retains bounded retry only for provider challenges, network failures, throttling, forbidden responses, and server failures.
Saves each page before scheduling the next traversal alarm and reschedules persisted collection work after browser startup or extension update.
Preserves duplicate-safe batch page delivery if a worker stops after server delivery but before local progress is saved.

releases.title: collectZ v3.31.3
releases.summary: Makes authenticated Blu-ray collection intake honest and recoverable when exact-product detail pages are throttled, challenged, or incomplete. Browser companion `0.3.1` applies bounded adaptive retry and can retry only failed editions in the existing batch, while CollectZ distinguishes a fully ready batch from one that is ready with issues.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Detects soft authentication and provider challenge pages returned with HTTP `200` instead of collapsing them into a generic parse failure.
Retries transient detail failures up to three times with increasing delay and slower inter-item pacing.
Preserves specific bounded detail failure reasons without storing raw private HTML, cookies, credentials, or authorization headers.
Derives enriched and failed detail totals from batch evidence and displays `Ready with issues` with a concise recovery path.
Lets the browser companion reload the current batch and retry only failed rows, preserving batch identity, ordering, already enriched rows, and reviewer-controlled decisions.
Preserves an unavailable collection count as unknown rather than coercing it to zero.

releases.title: collectZ v3.31.2
releases.summary: Turns authenticated Blu-ray collection receipts into an evidence-first review workflow. Browser companion `0.3.0` validates and enriches each collection row from its exact Blu-ray.com product page, while CollectZ exposes edition identity, format, identifiers, technical facts, source links, and provenance before any import can be included or applied.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Traverses numeric pages within the same filtered collection so one collector run remains one batch.
Treats a verified `My Collection` page as owned-collection evidence and records that ownership basis separately from product detail evidence.

Fetches product details sequentially with conservative delay, validates exact Blu-ray product identity, and retains bounded release, identifier, format, edition, cover, specification, rating, and source evidence.
Shows honest enriched, partial, and failed states across Editions, Technical, Source, and Provenance review tabs.
Starts every enriched owned edition Pending and requires an explicit reviewer Include decision.
Rejects Apply when no reviewed editions are included instead of reporting an empty success.

releases.title: collectZ v3.31.1
releases.summary: Extends reviewed Blu-ray intake from one title at a time to a bounded, resumable collection workflow. The browser companion traverses pages with the user's existing provider session, submits normalized edition evidence without credentials or cookies, and CollectZ presents one conflict-first review batch before any owned records are applied.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Adds exact-library collection batch receipts and duplicate-safe child intake records through additive migration `150`.

Adds authenticated Blu-ray.com traversal to browser companion `0.2.0`, with sequential page requests, jitter, a 100-page ceiling, and safe pauses for sign-in, challenge, rate-limit, forbidden, empty, or network responses.
Keeps provider cookies and credentials in the active browser tab; only bounded title, product identity, status, format, year, source URL, and capture timing evidence reaches CollectZ.
Groups a traversal into one Capture Inbox batch row with conflict-first review, a full-set toggle, keyboard-accessible edition navigation, and explicit Include or Skip decisions.

Applies only rows with an explicit Owned status. Each included row independently reuses the existing reviewed single-title path and therefore retains Work, Edition, Owned Copy, cover/format compatibility projection, and immutable source provenance behavior.
Preserves successful rows when a sibling row fails and leaves failed rows available for retry.

releases.title: collectZ v3.31.0
releases.summary: Begins the broader Work/Edition/Owned Copy program through the existing reviewed single-title Blu-ray intake flow. One movie title can now own exact Blu-ray Editions and idempotent library copies while current media and variant behavior remains compatible.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Adds exact-library Work, Edition, Owned Copy, and immutable Edition Source Observation records behind additive migration `148`.
Uses Blu-ray.com product identity to upsert one exact Edition and the Capture Inbox receipt to create at most one Owned Copy.
Retains normalized release facts as immutable edition evidence and appends a new observation only when the normalized evidence changes.
Rejects silent Edition reassignment and cross-workspace/library relationships.
Keeps `media` and `media_variants` as compatibility projections so existing title, owned-format, identifier, cover, trailer, and valuation behavior continues.
Shows the Work, Edition, and Owned Copy outcomes in the Capture Inbox before apply and returns their created/reused identities afterward.

releases.title: collectZ v3.30.0
releases.summary: Preserves BookOrbit 3.10 edition groups as immutable, reviewable provider provenance while keeping each BookOrbit book identity and CollectZ Canonical Object distinct.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Accepts bounded BookOrbit edition names, first-publication years, group ids, lead status, the current edition summary, and visible sibling editions from identity-matched native detail responses.
Represents every edition by its stable `urn:bookorbit:book:{id}` identity and rejects mismatched, duplicate, oversized, or structurally invalid groups.
Omits BookOrbit reading progress, last-read activity, internal library ids, credentials, endpoints, and raw payloads from retained observation facts.
Adds Provider history presentation for the observed group, current BookOrbit record, provider-selected lead, edition labels, formats, and sibling identities.
Keeps edition relationships outside canonical metadata comparison/review/apply, duplicate merging, and identity-rematch scoring.
Extends BookOrbit transport, authoritative import, OpenAPI, browser, and source-observation coverage for the BookOrbit 3.10 contract.

releases.title: collectZ v3.29.12
releases.summary: Adds a read-only, exact-library preview of possible canonical targets for an existing BookOrbit External Identity, using bounded observation evidence and explicit conflict blockers without moving anything.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Added deterministic candidate discovery from explicit BookOrbit provider identifiers, normalized ISBN, book title/author, and comic series/issue/volume evidence.
Restricts discovery to the active workspace and exact library, excludes the currently attached record, and returns no internal identity ids or provider configuration.
Labels candidate confidence, matched evidence, and conflicts such as mismatched identifiers, ISBN, media type, comic position, or an existing different BookOrbit identity.
Added a compact read-only Identity match preview to Library Provider history, including loading, empty, eligible, and blocked states.
Fingerprints the immutable observation and candidate state for a later reviewed-rematch contract while keeping `mutationEnabled` false.

releases.title: collectZ v3.29.11
releases.summary: Extends reviewed provider observation apply to credential-safe BookOrbit and Kavita cover references, with a visual current-versus-provider comparison and the existing exact-plan, preserve-only, and immutable-audit protections.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Added `media.poster_path` to the observation comparison allowlist only for exact CollectZ-owned BookOrbit or Kavita proxy paths.
Reconstructs eligible historical BookOrbit cover candidates from immutable connection, identity, and observed cover-version evidence without a data backfill.
Rejects direct upstream, cross-origin, malformed, unsupported-provider, and identity-mismatched cover values.
Added responsive current, observed, proposed, previous, and applied cover previews with understandable missing-image and load-failure states.
Reuses explicit approve/reject/defer review, exact-plan confirmation, atomic apply, reviewed preserve-only field authority, and immutable before/after history.
Keeps provider refresh, provider selection, identity rematching, automatic cover replacement, and provider image-byte import out of scope.

releases.title: collectZ v3.29.10
releases.summary: Adds an explicit, atomic way to apply still-current approved BookOrbit or Kavita observation fields to CollectZ while preserving immutable before/after evidence and preventing automatic future overwrite.

details.heading: Highlights
bullets: Added exact-preview fingerprints and stale-plan rejection for approved provider metadata.
Applies all still-eligible approved fields atomically and records reviewed, preserve-only field authority.
Added immutable exact-library-scoped apply events with bounded before/after field evidence.
Added Provider history confirmation, loading, blocker, success, and applied-history states.
Surfaces selected metadata-provider ids, observed series memberships, and cover provenance alongside reviewable canonical differences.
Keeps provider writeback, automatic refresh, cover application, identity rematching, and provider selection out of scope.
